en.hubeali: H 14644 – A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al-Hajjaal, from hammaad, from Al-Halby, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws said:
‘Intermingle with the people to find out about them, and when you find out about them, (only then) travel/associate with them’.
en.sarwar: 196. A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al-Hajjaal, from hammaad, from Al-Halby, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) said:
‘Intermingle with the people to find out about them, and when you find out about them, (only then) travel/associate with them’.
